high_level_description: This image captures a serene evening scene on a city street. Two individuals are walking away from the camera on the right side of the street. They appear to be engaged in conversation or simply enjoying the evening stroll. Their attire suggests it might be a cooler evening, as they are dressed in jackets. Streetlights: Several modern, curved streetlights line the sidewalk, providing illumination for the area.
